text:
Newton starts by putting 1 apple in his pocket and throwing the other, leaving him with 1 apple in his pocket.

5 more apples fall. He puts all but one into his pocket (4 apples) and throws the remaining 1. He now has $1 + 4 = 5$ apples in his pocket.

6 more apples fall, and he picks up all of them.

Total apples brought home: $5 + 6 = 11$.

ANSWER: 11
